SEARCH
Module org.egothor.radixor
Package org.egothor.stemmer

Class StemmerPatchTrieLoader

java.lang.Object
org.egothor.stemmer.StemmerPatchTrieLoader
public final class StemmerPatchTrieLoader extends Object
Loader of patch-command tries from bundled stemmer dictionaries.

Each dictionary is line-oriented and uses a tab-separated values layout. The first column on a line is interpreted as the stem, and all following tab-separated columns are treated as known variants of that stem.

For each line, the loader inserts:

  • the stem itself mapped to the canonical no-op patch command PatchCommandEncoder.NOOP_PATCH, when requested by the caller
  • every distinct variant mapped to the patch command transforming that variant to the stem using the traversal direction implied by the selected language or loader overload

Parsing is delegated to StemmerDictionaryParser, which also supports line remarks introduced by # or // and ignores dictionary items containing Unicode whitespace characters while reporting them through aggregated warning log records.

  • Method Details

    • load

      @Deprecated(since="2.3.0", forRemoval=false) public static FrequencyTrie<String> load(StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language language, boolean storeOriginal, ReductionSettings reductionSettings) throws IOException
      Deprecated.
      Since 2.3.0 for runtime stemming. Use loadCompiled(Language, boolean, ReductionSettings) so patch commands are represented as CompiledPatchCommand values instead of reparsed String values.
      Loads the language's registered default model using explicit reduction settings.

      This overload applies the following implicit compilation defaults in addition to the supplied reductionSettings:

      • traversal direction is derived from StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language.isRightToLeft() (WordTraversalDirection.FORWARD for right-to-left languages, WordTraversalDirection.BACKWARD otherwise)
      • case processing mode is CaseProcessingMode.LOWERCASE_WITH_LOCALE_ROOT
      • diacritic processing mode is DiacriticProcessingMode.AS_IS

      The resolved settings are persisted into TrieMetadata of the resulting trie.

      Parameters:
      language - language whose stable default model is required
      storeOriginal - whether the stem itself should be inserted using the canonical no-op patch command
      reductionSettings - reduction settings
      Returns:
      compiled patch-command trie
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
      IOException - if the dictionary cannot be found or read

    • loadCompiled

      public static FrequencyTrie<CompiledPatchCommand> loadCompiled(StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language language, boolean storeOriginal, ReductionSettings reductionSettings) throws IOException
      Loads the language's registered default model and returns a runtime-specialized trie whose values are compiled patch commands.

      The text dictionary is still compiled through the canonical serialized patch-command representation. The returned trie replaces each stored serialized patch command with a CompiledPatchCommand so repeated runtime stemming does not parse patch-command strings.

      Parameters:
      language - language whose stable default model is required
      storeOriginal - whether the stem itself should be inserted using the canonical no-op patch command
      reductionSettings - reduction settings
      Returns:
      compiled patch-command trie with runtime-specialized values
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
      IOException - if the dictionary cannot be found or read

    • load

      public static FrequencyTrie<String> load(StemmerModelDescriptor descriptor, boolean storeOriginal, TrieMetadata metadata) throws IOException
      Loads an explicitly selected descriptor using trie compilation metadata.

      The method opens the descriptor's namespaced resource through its discovering class loader, verifies SHA-256 over the compressed bytes, decompresses the GZip UTF-8 dictionary, parses it, and builds a trie. Each invocation performs this work and returns serialized patch-command values.

      Parameters:
      descriptor - exact validated model descriptor
      storeOriginal - whether canonical stems receive no-op mappings
      metadata - trie compilation configuration
      Returns:
      newly built trie containing serialized patch-command strings
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if descriptor or metadata is null
      IOException - if the compressed dictionary cannot be read or decompressed
      StemmerModelIntegrityException - if the resource is missing or its checksum differs

    • loadCompiled

      public static FrequencyTrie<CompiledPatchCommand> loadCompiled(StemmerModelDescriptor descriptor, boolean storeOriginal, ReductionMode reductionMode) throws IOException
      Loads one exact model descriptor and returns a runtime-specialized trie.

      The descriptor's compressed dictionary is integrity-checked, fully parsed, reduced with the supplied mode, and converted to immutable CompiledPatchCommand values. The method does not consult a language default and does not cache the constructed trie. Applications should retain the result for their intended runtime scope. Constructing exceptionally large models can require substantial temporary heap.

      Parameters:
      descriptor - exact validated model descriptor
      storeOriginal - whether canonical stems receive no-op mappings
      reductionMode - reduction mode applied during trie construction
      Returns:
      newly constructed trie containing compiled patch commands
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if descriptor or reductionMode is null
      IOException - if the compressed dictionary cannot be read or decompressed
      StemmerModelIntegrityException - if the resource is missing or its checksum differs

    • loadModel

      public static FrequencyTrie<String> loadModel(String modelId, boolean storeOriginal, TrieMetadata metadata) throws IOException
      Loads an exact model ID through a newly discovered context-class-loader registry.

      This method is distinct from load(String, ...), whose string is a filesystem path. Selection is exact and never falls back to another model for the same language.

      Parameters:
      modelId - exact stable model identifier
      storeOriginal - whether canonical stems receive no-op mappings
      metadata - trie compilation configuration
      Returns:
      newly built trie containing serialized patch-command strings
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if modelId or metadata is null
      IOException - if discovery or resource reading fails
      StemmerModelNotFoundException - if the model is not visible
      DuplicateStemmerModelException - if discovery finds duplicate IDs
      UnsupportedStemmerModelFormatException - if discovery finds an unsupported format
      StemmerModelIntegrityException - if metadata or resource integrity is invalid

      @Deprecated(since="2.3.0", forRemoval=false) public static FrequencyTrie<String> load(StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language language, boolean storeOriginal, ReductionMode reductionMode) throws IOException
      Deprecated.
      Since 2.3.0 for runtime stemming. Use loadCompiled(Language, boolean, ReductionMode) so patch commands are represented as CompiledPatchCommand values.
      Loads the language's registered default model using settings for the supplied reduction mode.

      storeOriginal - whether the stem itself should be inserted using the canonical no-op patch command
      reductionMode - reduction mode
      Returns:

      Throws:

      IOException - if the dictionary cannot be found or read

      This overload is equivalent to calling load(Path, boolean, ReductionSettings) with ReductionSettings.withDefaults(ReductionMode) and therefore uses implicit defaults (WordTraversalDirection.BACKWARD, CaseProcessingMode.LOWERCASE_WITH_LOCALE_ROOT, DiacriticProcessingMode.AS_IS).

      Parameters:
      path - path to the dictionary file
      storeOriginal - whether the stem itself should be inserted using the canonical no-op patch command
      reductionMode - reduction mode
      Returns:
      compiled patch-command trie
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
      IOException - if the file cannot be opened or read

    • loadCompiled

      public static FrequencyTrie<CompiledPatchCommand> loadCompiled(String modelId, boolean storeOriginal, ReductionMode reductionMode) throws IOException
      Loads one exact stable model identifier and returns a runtime-specialized trie.

      The registry is discovered through the thread context class loader. Selection is exact: the method never resolves a language default, falls back to another model, or depends on classpath order. Use loadCompiled(Path, boolean, ReductionMode) for a filesystem path.

      Parameters:
      modelId - exact stable model identifier
      storeOriginal - whether the stem itself should be inserted using the canonical no-op patch command
      reductionMode - reduction mode
      Returns:
      compiled patch-command trie with runtime-specialized values
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if modelId is blank
      IOException - if registry discovery or dictionary reading fails
      StemmerModelNotFoundException - if the exact model is not visible
      DuplicateStemmerModelException - if discovery finds duplicate model IDs
      UnsupportedStemmerModelFormatException - if a descriptor format is unsupported
      StemmerModelIntegrityException - if descriptor or resource integrity validation fails

      Loads a GZip-compressed binary patch-command trie from a filesystem path and returns runtime-specialized compiled patch values.
